title: AlphaRJM: Reward-Jump Memory for Stochastic Return-Guided Alpha Discovery
abstract: arXiv:2609.08581v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Formulaic alpha discovery is a pool-dependent symbolic search problem in which informative feedback is observed primarily when a complete expression is evaluated. This delayed feedback creates two coupled difficulties: the retained alpha pool does not preserve the full history of realized evaluation feedback, and the value of an intermediate construction action is uncertain because its consequence depends on the formula eventually completed. We introduce AlphaRJM, which addresses these difficulties through Reward-Jump Memory, an event-driven latent state that remains fixed during token construction and updates only at terminal evaluation events using the realized pool reward and evaluation outcome, and an action-conditioned SDE return critic that represents future discounted discovery returns with stochastic particles. translated_title: AlphaRJM：用于随机收益引导的Alpha因子发现的奖励跳跃记忆
translated_abstract: 公式化Alpha因子发现是一个依赖因子池的符号搜索问题，其中有效的反馈主要在完整表达式被评估时才能观察到。这种延迟反馈带来了两个相互耦合的困难：保留的Alpha因子池不能保存已实现评估反馈的完整历史，且中间构建动作的价值是不确定的，因为其后果取决于最终完成的公式。我们提出了AlphaRJM，通过奖励跳跃记忆来解决这些困难——这是一种事件驱动的潜在状态，在token构建过程中保持固定，仅在终端评估事件时使用已实现的因子池奖励和评估结果进行更新；同时引入一个动作条件化的SDE收益评论家，用随机粒子来表示未来折现的发现收益。这些粒子通过其均值和不确定性来引导动作选择，并使用分布式贝尔曼算子进行学习……
tldr: 提出AlphaRJM框架，通过仅在终端评估事件时更新的奖励跳跃记忆和使用随机粒子表示未来收益的动作条件化SDE评论家，解决了公式化Alpha发现中延迟反馈导致的因子池历史信息丢失与中间动作价值不确定的难题。
en_tdlr: AlphaRJM tackles delayed-feedback challenges in formulaic alpha discovery by introducing Reward-Jump Memory—an event-driven latent state updated only at terminal evaluations—and an action-conditioned SDE return critic that uses stochastic particles to guide action selection.
